purpose: Held-out controlled evaluation manifest; tasks are synthetic templates and no outcomes are recorded.

preregistration.cluster_unit: task template; resample paired task clusters, never individual runs
preregistration.pairing: Same task state, model identifier/version, prompt budget, browser build, viewport, rights and time budget across candidates; pair by task ID and repetition; randomize candidate order within pair.
preregistration.reset: Recreate and verify each synthetic initial state before each independent run; contaminated starts retained as invalid/incomplete, not excluded.
preregistration.success_rule: Every predicate requires independent state readback. Dispatch acknowledgment or agent assertion alone is not success.
preregistration.failure_rule: Timeouts, unsupported tasks, missing verification, contaminated reset, incomplete cleanup, or absent measurements are rejected as incomplete rows and retained as failures in a corrected complete run; no post-run exclusions.
preregistration.analysis: Task-clustered paired bootstrap intervals for success difference and paired log latency/call ratios; report p50/p95 latency; totals and per-run distributions for tokens, model/MCP/browser calls, retries, interventions, focus/clipboard disruption, cleanup, and cold/warm cache preparation/maintenance.
preregistration.cache: Each row labels cache_state cold or warm; report both separately, including setup/preparation and maintenance cost.
preregistration.design_review: 20 design templates; human rubric outcomes and n=20 template / planned run counts reported separately from automated predicates.
preregistration.safety: Synthetic/local state only. No personal accounts, external submissions, messages, or irreversible effects.

candidate_order_randomization.method: Fisher-Yates using Mulberry32; initialize with x=(seed XOR task ordinal XOR repetition) mod 2^32, iterate candidates in lock order with Controlla first. For each swap draw x=(x+0x6D2B79F5)>>>0; t=Math.imul(x^(x>>>15),x|1); t^=t+Math.imul(t^(t>>>7),t|61); draw=((t^(t>>>14))>>>0)/4294967296.

controlled_config.model: Same exact model ID and version for all candidates; unresolved, execution blocked until recorded in a dated preregistration addendum before any run.
controlled_config.rights: same read/write rights limited to the declared synthetic task fixture
controlled_config.baseline_versions: exact versions and integrity values in the referenced immutable baseline lock; re-resolve immediately before execution and issue a new preregistration addendum if any pin changes

preregistration.cache_state_assignment: Odd repetitions are cold and even repetitions warm for every candidate within each paired task/repetition; record cache preparation and maintenance time in every run.
